statement: Use "Text Auto Complete" in the Text editor; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in the Text editor with "Toggle Comments"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Run the data operation "Convert Whitespace" on the current selection in the Text editor; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.
Copy content in the Text editor with "Copy"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in the Text editor with "Set Cursor"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Run the data operation "Cut" on the current selection in the Text editor; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.
Remove or clear content in the Text editor with "Delete"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Copy content in the Text editor with "Duplicate Line"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.
Change the view or current position in the Text editor with "Find Next" so the user can inspect the result; only view state or the current frame changes, never model data.
